title: Mera Abbas Ghazi
body:
ghuroore fauje sitamgar ko tod sakta hoo
rukhe furaat nigahon se mod sakta hoo
ali ka beta hoo mojiz numaiyon ki qasam
mai aftaab se pani nichod sakta hoo
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas ghazi abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
maani e riffat e esaar o wafa hai abbas
jazba e hausla e sher e khuda hai abbas
rooh e ehsaas e rasool e do sara hai abbas
yaani allah ke maqsad ki baqa hai abbas
raasta rehbar e islam ki rukne na diya
kath gaye haath alam deen ka jhukne na diya
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jo ejaaz dikhaun to ye naksha badle
arsh pe fasl ugay farsh pe suraj nikle
nehr se gard udhe sang se chashma phoothe
aag pani may lage aag se pani nikle
ghoor ke dekhun to tum sab pe mammaat aajaye
mere toote huwe naize pe furaat aa jaaye
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri talwaar se jibreel ke par kaampte hai
meri haibat se sabhi jinn o bashar kaampte hai
tum to kya cheez ho sher'on ke jigar kaampte hai
maut se pehle hi ajsaam ke sar kaampte hai
maine talwaar jo ek baar chalayi hoti
saari dunya may duhaai hi duhaai hoti
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang e siffain ka maahol dobara hojaye
khaynch loo taygh to dunya may savera hojaye
alqama ko jo mera ek ishaara hojaye
qaima e shaah hi darya ka kanara hojaye
khatm pyason ki abhi tashnadahani kardun
mai agar chaahun pahadon ko bhi pani kardun
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
poore maqtal ko ek ungli pe nacha sakta hoo
tum jo mar jao to thokar se jila sakta hoo
aag behte huwe pani may laga sakta hoo
tum ko ab rooh ke ishaare se bhaga sakta hoo
haath katne pe bhi ladne se mai mazoor nahi
hukme shabbir ka paband hoo majboor nahi
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haa magar gardish e dauran ne ye manzar dekha
kat gaye baazu e abbas sare raah e wafa
sar pe bhi gurz laga aankh pe bhi teer laga
aas bhi toot gayi mashk se pani jo baha
ho salaam aap pe aaqa ye pukare abbas
nehr se jaanib e firdaus sidhare abbas
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab suna nehr pe saqqa e haram maara gaya
gir gayi bibyon ke sar se ye sunte hi rida
bibi zainab ki sada aane lagi wawaila
gir gaya daste sakina se zameen par kooza
boli ye ro ke mujhe aas nahi hai ammu
jald aajao ke ab pyaas nahi hai ammu
mera abbas ghazi abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke shabbir pukare mere bhaiya abbas
mere ghamkhwar mere aashiq o shaida abbas
mujhko pani to pilado mai hoo pyasa abbas
mai gira jaata hoo do mujhko sahara abbas
qaima e fatema zehra ki sipar toot gayi
haath bhai ke kate meri kamar toot gayi
